$schema_note: Per-module coverage ratchet baseline (FR-251 Gap #1). Keys are repo-relative file paths; values are the highest coverage percentage recorded for that file. Pre-push hook and CI both compare current coverage against these baselines and FAIL when a touched file drops below its recorded floor. The baseline ONLY GOES UP — every PR that improves coverage for a file MUST update the entry; entries are never lowered. To seed an entry: run `docker compose exec -T backend python manage.py measure_coverage --module <path> --json` and paste the line_pct value here (rounded to one decimal place).
